decision_rule.quality: Require no lower useful-task outcome on every frozen task and greater on at least one; lifecycle and native keyless/no-prompt/route conditions are mandatory gates

decision_rule.fallback: Keep the measured native baseline; record invalid/unqualified comparisons separately from task failures
